newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Forbo sees 1997 profit above 60 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Forbo sees 1997 profit above 60 mln Sfr.

text.p: Swiss floor and wall coverings maker Forbo AG said it expected its 1997 profit to be above 60 million Swiss francs.
"After the first months of 1997 it appears that we can hold the profit level of 1996 before extraordinary provisions," Forbo chief executive Rene Ruepp said.
Forbo's 1996 profit, before the provision, was 61.0 million Swiss francs. It had 1996 net income of 31.0 million francs, down from 55.6 million in 1995.
The 30 million franc provision was linked to the divestment of non-core activities.
